## Species composition of the biosphere
<hr>
<br/>

<div style="float: left; width: 50%;">

* **Intricate webs of interacting organisms**
    + ~2,200,000 species are described
    + ~17,000 new species described each year
    + estimated ~8.7 million eukaryotic species exist

<br/>

* **Current composition reflects billions of ways organisms have adapted, over and over, to a changing planet**

<br/>

* **Humans have altered 75% of ice-free surface**
    + impacts livable habitats
    + impacts climate
    + impacts species diversity
    
 </div>

## Biogeography and animal ranges: Alfred Wallace 1859
<hr>

<IMG STYLE="position:absolute; TOP:180px; LEFT:10px; WIDTH:500px; HEIGHT:500px" SRC="images/wallaces-line.png">

<div style="float: right; width: 50%;">

* **Wallace line is an invisible boundary separating the distinct animal species of Asia from the species of Australasia**
    + cuts a famous 20 mile gap between Bali and Lombok
    
<br/>

* **The line represents a deep ocean channel and separation of two tectonic plates**
    + biogeographical barrier for animals
    + even during ice ages, deep water channel remained
    + rainforst birds refuse to fly over open ocean water!

<br/>

* **Wallace's observations lead to his theory of evolution (at the same times as Darwin!)**
    
 </div>
